test: migrate tests to msw v3 and upgrade TypeScript for PR #10

- Upgrade typescript to ^5.9.3 and ts-jest to ^29.4.15 (keeping jest 29 with 0 audit vulnerabilities)
- Configure Jest + ts-jest to run tests with Node VM modules for ESM-only msw v3
- Migrate all 4 test suites from msw v1 (rest, req/res/ctx, onUnhandledRequest) to msw v3 (http, HttpResponse, onUnhandledFrame)
- Use default https import in src/version/container-references.ts so ClientRequestInterceptor can intercept https.request under ESM
- Pin Node 24 in rebuild-dist.yml and rebuild dist/index.js

Fixes #11
